# Atomic Provenance

Every retrievable assertion is a Claim derived from a Block.
The Claim records `prov:wasDerivedFrom`, `prov:wasGeneratedBy`, and `prov:wasAttributedTo` edges.

This #traceability requirement is the MVP success gate for [[Marginalia]].
